title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Leaving the Program, Re-Enrollment and Closing Figures
content:
**Term 1.** A member may convert a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) account back to standard monthly billing only after the tier's minimum full calendar months since activation, and only with a paid security deposit held on the service account where the tier requires one.

**Term 2.** Arrears not yet recovered when the enrollment is converted or closed are billed back on the service account as a program charge.

**Term 3.** After a conversion, the same service account may enroll again only after the tier's re-enrollment wait in calendar days.

**Term 4.** A low-balance disconnection may last the tier's finaling period in calendar days before the enrollment is closed and the service account final billed.

**Term 5.** At closing, a remaining prepaid balance of at least the refund check minimum is refunded by check; a smaller remainder is credited to the service account's final bill.

| Tier | Minimum months before conversion | Deposit required to convert | Unrecovered arrears at exit | Re-enrollment wait (calendar days) | Finaling period while disconnected (calendar days) | Refund check minimum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 3 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 30 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 6 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 30 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 6 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 30 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 3 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 30 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 3 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 30 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 3 | yes | billed back on the service account | 90 | 15 | 5.00 |

Illustration (hypothetical): at closing a remaining balance of 5.00 is refunded by check, while 4.99 is credited to the final bill.
